chain_trace.break_detail: The script link is internally inconsistent: the oracle expectation (ids 1201-1204, plus 1101-1104/1301-1304 in F2/F4) contradicts the script's own fixture generator (g02 ids are 2100-2103; no 12xx ids exist). The log's DEFECT_FOUND verdict is the downstream artifact of that oracle error — the raw HTTP observation itself is correct behavior (200, exactly one group g02 with exactly its 4 points). Per dispatch instruction the F1 observation did not survive fixture reconstruction, so the filter-before-group vs filter-after-group source forensics was run only as corroboration (see source_grounding), and the oracle error is recorded as the mundane explanation.

source_grounding.call_chain_traced: REST groups request -> CollectionQueryGroupsRequest{filter: Option<Filter>} (collection_query.rs L73-87, filter at L77) -> From<CollectionQueryGroupsRequest> wraps the user filter into the source CollectionQueryRequest (group_by.rs L285-297) -> group_by() merges the user filter with group/id exclusions into source.filter (L339-369) -> request.r#do() executes the filtered point search (L372-380) -> only already-filtered points reach GroupsAggregator (aggregator.rs L46+). Filter is therefore applied BEFORE grouping: a filter grp==g02 must produce exactly one group 'g02' whose hits are g02's own point ids (2100-2103 in this fixture) — exactly the observed response. Source and observed behavior agree; the script oracle disagrees with both.

mundane_explanation.surviving: CONFIRMED mundane explanation: script oracle/fixture id-scheme mismatch. The oracle table was authored for id blocks 1000+gi*100 (g01->1101-1104, g02->1201-1204, g03->1301-1304) while the executed fixture generator emits gi*1000+100+k (g01->1100-1103, g02->2100-2103, g03->3100-3103); expected ids 1201-1204 are unreachable by construction, so F1 (and F2/F4 had execution reached them) could never pass. The API's filter-before-group semantics are correct (behaviorally and per source). The DEFECT_FOUND verdict is an artifact of the script, not an API defect; the same oracle family also produced semantic_points_query_groups_semantics_001's false-positive verdict.
